text: My daily routine is built on consistency, which helps me stay productive and relaxed. I wake up at six-thirty every morning and start with a glass of water and ten minutes of stretching. After a quick shower and breakfast, I begin my work at nine, focusing on tasks until a short lunch break at noon. In the afternoon, I take a thirty-minute walk or do a light workout to recharge. By evening, I prepare dinner, read for a while, and write in my journal. I turn off all screens by ten and am asleep by ten-thirty. This regular schedule keeps my body and mind healthy.
